scope: Outcome-blind completion of the four unobserved tasks in frozen Wave 2 sentinel tranche 2 for the 30-task proportional checkpoint

checkpoint_design.selection_rule: Complete every still-missing Wave 1 task and the four not-yet-run tasks in frozen Wave 2 sentinel tranche 2.
checkpoint_design.revision_reason: Reduce concurrency from four to the observed safe Daytona ceiling of three before any selected Wave 2 task was run.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one four-route task at a time, at most three concurrent Harbor trials, followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Complete all four tasks before using their outcomes to choose any follow-on task. Infrastructure failures remain excluded and are recovered route-for-route.
